reason: A short KEEP window can start after identity swaps, so its first match does not identify an originally correct track. A displaced public fragment of the same clicked identity is not another person's identity damage.
canonical_other_person_reference: First strictly verified GT identity in the generating source's actual prefix before the test frame, restricted to its current precommit existing public axis. GT is offline TRAIN label truth, never runtime evidence.
target_identity_reference: The sole human-confirmed initialization identity in separate offline truth.
same_target_fragments: Count affected public IDs and fragmentation separately; exclude them from other-person harm. Never assume candidate stealing is safe at runtime from this GT label.
short_window_continuity: Retain separately as diagnostic, not canonical training reward or proof of original identity correctness.
new_births: Do not assign arbitrary cross-branch public IDs the same future identity; preserve birth/death/ownership components and actual TrackEval diagnostics.
actual_metrics: This remains a semantic origin proxy, not true HOTA/AssA/IDF1. Actual same-setting intervention-window and full-policy TrackEval remain required.
synthetic_counterexamples: Restoring two previously swapped identities; recovering a newly born fragment of the clicked identity.
